|strategy=By [mailto:kesslpg@aol.com Greg McClanahan : kesslpg@aol.com]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/zevsenesca.html</ref>

When Zev pilots [[Rogue 2]], the maneuver of 7 makes it nearly impossible for the dark side to hit it with a weapon. But you can also put that maneuver to even better use with the [[Power Harpoon]]. After the Walker has crashed, finish it off with Duel Laser Cannons. Another stradegy is to watch your opponents face after seeing the armor of 7 not doing any good!
